question: Does the parity-block kernel reduce constrained FP64 product time beyond the strongest published implementation and an equal-mapping dense control, while retaining true-residual solver acceptance?

correctness.saved_states: All 15 cases of the prerequisite protocol, with saved displacements and independent C++ target products.
probes: seeded random vector with nonzero constrained entries

benchmarks.density: Deterministic heterogeneous synthetic field in [0.02,1]; no claim that it is an optimized design. Exact generation code and arrays frozen before rental.
benchmarks.input: Seeded random FP64 probe, same arrays for every path; x=0 fixed face with full identity on constrained rows.
benchmarks.order: Seeded random path permutation in each round; retain raw order, GPU event duration and synchronized host elapsed time.
benchmarks.timed_scope: Complete constrained product call, including required output zeroing, masking, kernel launches, assembly and constraint restoration. CPU data generation, transfers, setup/JIT and validation are outside steady-state time and reported separately; no whole-application claim.
benchmarks.measurement: CUDA events with end-event synchronization; also report elapsed host time for each batch. Never time asynchronously without synchronization.
benchmarks.per_case_criterion: For every baseline, paired median baseline/candidate GPU-event ratio >=1.15, and one-sided 95% paired bootstrap lower limit >1.05.

solver_check.algorithm: Unmodified donor Jacobi-PCG, exact common diagonal, identical physics and stopping settings for every path.
solver_check.order: Seeded random permutation of paths per case and replicate
solver_check.acceptance: All native and independently verified solutions pass. Small-mesh solver timings are diagnostics, not a large-scale speedup gate.
solver_check.negative_control: One-iteration cap on cantilever-q8-final must fail physical acceptance for every path.

development_gate: All declared correctness and solver checks pass; candidate meets every per-case timing criterion on both primary benchmark shapes. No omission of failing cases or baseline paths.
on_failure: Retain complete attempt and diagnose; do not lower the effect or correctness thresholds. A corrected implementation requires a fresh output directory and explicit provenance.
on_pass: Only an operator development premise passes. Independent rentals/devices, application-scale fully charged solver and optimizer timings, setup amortization, valid sensitivity chain and novelty validation still required before the original goal can pass.
